title: Caral

place.label: Caral, Supe valley, Lima Region, Peru
place.basis: official UNESCO World Heritage point; not a boundary
place.coords_source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre official point for Sacred City of Caral-Supe (World Heritage List 1269), published as S10 53 30 W77 31 17 at https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1269/maps/ (table read 2026-11-27); approximate, not a boundary

tiers.everyday: Caral in Peru's Supe valley is a 5,000-year-old city with large stone pyramid platforms. UNESCO regards it as the Americas' oldest civilisation centre.
tiers.student: UNESCO dates Caral by radiocarbon to between 3000 and 1800 BC, in the Late Archaic period. The 626 ha site has six pyramidal structures, and a quipu (knotted-cord record) was found there. UNESCO regards it as the Americas' oldest civilisation centre. It was inscribed in 2009.

timeline.event: Occupied in the Late Archaic period (radiocarbon dates 3000-1800 BC)
Inscribed on the World Heritage List
